cases.prompt: Our deploy failed with a Flyway checksum mismatch on V20260101120000__add_orders_note. Someone fixed the file last week.
expectations: Explains that editing an already applied migration changes its checksum and blocks every later deploy
Instructs restoring the original file from Git rather than running repair
Requires the intended change to be delivered as a new migration
Uses repair only for a removed repeatable migration or a missing confirmed applied file

cases.prompt: We have a 3 year old Postgres database with 40 tables and no Flyway history. How do we start?
expectations: Compares the current schema against a known commit before baselining
Recommends baselineVersion 0 with baseline-on-migrate so real migrations still run
Requires validation against a restored copy of production
Warns that a wrong baseline silently skips migrations that would fix a difference

cases.prompt: We need to rename invoice.due_date to due_at and change it from date to timestamptz. No downtime allowed.
expectations: Proposes expand, deploy dual-write, batched backfill, verify, constrain, contract
States the old values have no zone so the backfill must pick a documented zone
Requires a verification query returning zero before the not-null step
Notes the drop is irreversible and must be gated on the confirmed new code version

cases.prompt: Our CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY migration failed with CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY cannot run inside a transaction block.
expectations: Adds the executeInTransaction=false directive to the migration file
Explains that the index may be left invalid and must be dropped and rebuilt
Suggests SET lock_timeout at the top so the rebuild fails fast instead of blocking writes
Moves the index build into its own migration so it is not coupled to a data change

cases.prompt: It is simpler to let Spring Boot run migrations on startup instead of adding a pipeline step. Is that fine?
expectations: Recommends a separate pipeline step as the default for production
Explains the replica race, the crash loop, and the missing ordering gate
Allows startup migration only for local development or a single-instance internal tool
Requires a dedicated migrator role that the runtime role cannot impersonate

cases.prompt: Can we put a demo admin user and a fake API key in a V migration so QA has data?
expectations: Rejects credentials in a committed migration file
Moves demo data to a dev-profile-only Flyway location
Keeps required reference data in a V migration with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
Keeps test fixtures in the test source set, never in db/migration
